targets.expr: 100 * (1 - max by (host, role) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node",environment="$environment",host=~"$host"}) / max by (host, role) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node",environment="$environment",host=~"$host"}))

100 * (1 - max by (host, role) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node",environment="$environment",host=~"$host",mountpoint="/"}) / max by (host, role) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node",environment="$environment",host=~"$host",mountpoint="/"}))
max by (host, role) (node_load5{job="node",environment="$environment",host=~"$host"}) / count by (host, role) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",environment="$environment",host=~"$host",mode="idle"})

count by (host, role) (node_systemd_unit_state{job="node",environment="$environment",host=~"$host",state="failed"} == 1) or max by (host, role) (up{job="node",environment="$environment",host=~"$host"}) * 0

panels.title: I/O wait and steal
panels.description: Steal is CPU time taken by the hypervisor; sustained steal on cloud VMs means a noisy neighbour.

panels.title: Pressure stall (some tasks waiting)
panels.description: Share of time at least one task waited for CPU, memory or I/O (Linux PSI).

panels.title: Failed units
panels.description: Units currently in the failed state. Empty means everything is fine.

panels.title: Timers: time since last run
panels.description: ACME renewal timers are omitted; their failures show up in Failed units.
